_doc: CASTELLO dating cabinet (#16, built 2026-07-17 — opens Tier 2 Italian). The Italian premium marque with a REAL DATE CODE since 1987: the number inside the castle stamp = 1947 + n (40th-anniversary system; '50' in castle = 1997). Before 1987: grading-letter eras (SA/SB/SC/SS sizes -> uppercase K -> 1982 lowercase k-in-oval) + stamp/logo eras do the work. SOURCES (local-first per CABINET_METHOD): staging/pipedia/Castello_Dating_and_Information_Guide.json ★ (the Briar Blues guide by Mike Glukler, compiled with Franco 'Kino' Coppo via Marco Parascenzo, G.L. Pease, Bob Hamlin et al. — maker-adjacent authority) + staging/pipedia/Castello.json. Honesty flags: pre-K grading window 'late 1950s to mid-1960s' encoded wide 1955-1966; uppercase-K start 'late 1960s/early 1970s' encoded 1968; Big Line kept as FLOOR only (stamp continued on huge pipes after 1972).

history_anchors._doc: 1947 Carlo Scotti founds the firm in Cantu. 1947-1949/50 pipes stamped 'Mi Reserva'; 'Reg No' added later (= trademark registration number, NOT a shape number). Wally Frank Ltd = early US distributor (their 'White Bar' pipe line forced Castello to change its own white-bar stem logo for the US); Hollco Rohr takes over US distribution mid-to-late 1960s (Old Sea Rock + rhinestone = US-only Hollco items; brief 'Antiquari' fume-top import). 1967 Natural Vergin first issued (series production from 1985). 1969 Franco 'Kino' Coppo joins; late 60s/early 70s = switch to fully handmade + uppercase-K grading. 1982 grading switches to lowercase k in oval/circle. 1984-85 Kino takes over the firm. 1987 (40th anniversary) number-in-castle date stamp begins. 1992 Carlo Scotti dies. 1997 'US' stamp begins. 2007 (60th anniversary) 'KINO' stamp begins. Shape numbers: 2-digit; 2xx prefix = fancy interpretation, 3xx = unique carving (currently a pi symbol instead of 3xx). Shop stamps (provenance, not dates): N1 Novelli, N Noli, F Fincato, LO Lorenzi (+ '*'), B Bonfiglioli, BO/B15 Bollito, V Agide, SO Scarafioffi, JO Osstermann (Austria), R3 Ruocco, L Lanzola, US = US distributor.

brand_marks.physical: Stem logos: white bar = the first logo; faux diamond (rhinestone) = created for the US market (Wally Frank conflict), still occasionally set to keep the trademark alive; black dot = used on white Lucite stems. No Vulcanite-stemmed faux-diamond Castello ever documented (guide). Grading: SA/SB/SC/SS sizes (pre-K era) -> uppercase K (size; on smooths grain+size) -> 1982+ lowercase k in oval (kk+) or circle (single k) + G/GG/GL tiers.

date_code._doc: Number INSIDE the castle stamp = 1947 + n. Began 1987 (n=40, the 40th anniversary) -> a castle number BELOW 40 should not exist = confirm-flow; '50' = 1997. EXACT tier.

line_years._notes: natural vergin: first issued 1967 (series from 1985) -> floor 1967. great line: replaced Big Line 1972 -> approx floor. big line: stamp PRIMARILY 1968-1972 but 'still used on huge pipes' after -> FLOOR only, never a ceiling; a Big Line + uppercase-K + no castle number profile lands 1968-72 via feature convergence. old sea rock: US-only Hollco Rohr item (distribution mid-late 1960s) -> approx floor 1965, verify. NOT encoded (no dates in sources): sea rock (early days -> no value), trademark, collection, perla nera, occhio di pernice, fiammata, aristocratica, dune (current-catalogue names), antiquari-brief-import (single mention, 'a couple of years', undated).

table.label: 'Mi Reserva' stamp = the founding era 1947-1949/50 (guide; Reg No added later)
pre-K size letters SA/SB/SC/SS = 'late 1950s to mid-1960s' -> wide honest 1955-1966
uppercase K grading = late-1960s (Kino joined 1969) until the 1982 switch; also the machine->fully-handmade transition years
lowercase k in oval (multi-k) / circle (single k) = 1982+ (documented switch year)
white bar = the FIRST stem logo; changed for the US when Wally Frank's own 'White Bar' line clashed — end year undocumented -> wide honest 1970 end, approx

channels_future.faux_diamond: faux-diamond/rhinestone stem = US-market marker (Wally Frank/Hollco eras); START YEAR undocumented in our sources -> identification only, no bracket. If a dated source lands, encode as stem_logo era.
channels_future.black_dot: black dot = white-Lucite-stem pipes, undated -> identification only.
channels_future.shop_stamps: N1/N/F/LO/B/BO/B15/V/SO/JO/R3/L/US = retailer provenance marks (see history_anchors); LO adds '*'. Not dates; useful for provenance stories.
channels_future.colored_lucite: colored Lucite stems 'used in the 1970s, and on occasion today' -> too leaky for a bracket; confirm-flow hint only.
